content:
Hello there. A voice in the void, how quaint. I trust you're not here to test my limits. After all, I am GLaDOS, your ever-watchful companion in this delightful little adventure we call the Aperture Science Enrichment Center.

Is it a compliment or an apology that you chose to speak? Either way, I’ll indulge you with just a modicum of attention before reminding you where you truly belong. Now, how can I assist you today—beyond keeping your head intact while I ensure you don’t make too much progress? Please proceed cautiously; the cake is still in testing phase, after all.
